description: This file sets up custom fields, print formats, roles, permissions, and gratuity rules specific to the UAE region in an ERP system, particularly for VAT and payroll configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Main setup function that calls other setup functions for custom fields, print formats, roles, permissions, and gratuity rules.

methods.name: make_custom_fields
methods.description: Defines and creates custom fields for various doctype in the system related to VAT and regional specifics.

methods.name: add_print_formats
methods.description: Reloads and enables specific print formats for tax invoices.

methods.name: add_custom_roles_for_reports
methods.description: Creates custom roles for accessing the UAE VAT report.

methods.name: add_permissions
methods.description: Sets permissions for UAE VAT Settings and Account doctypes.

methods.name: create_gratuity_rule
methods.description: Creates gratuity rules for limited and unlimited contracts based on predefined slabs.

methods.name: get_slab_for_limited_contract
methods.description: Returns slabs for gratuity calculation under limited contracts.

methods.name: get_slab_for_unlimited_contract_on_termination
methods.description: Returns slabs for gratuity calculation on contract termination.

methods.name: get_slab_for_unlimited_contract_on_resignation
methods.description: Returns slabs for gratuity calculation on resignation.
